reason: The triclinic metric and likely Z=1 are well supported by indexing, but exact recovery is not established. No comparable whole-pattern score was supplied; the reported R values are solver-specific unweighted profile residuals. More importantly, selected.cif is physically untenable, with Pb-O about 1.045 A, Cu-O about 1.430 A, Cu-Pb about 1.849 A, and no Fe-O neighbor within 3.0 A. alternative-1.cif has a much worse reported profile residual (about 0.188 versus 0.104) and remains markedly undercoordinated. The trajectory fixed Cu at the origin, explored only limited P-1/P1 basins, and did not explicitly compare plausible Fe/Cu orderings or adequately establish P1 over P-1; absence conditions cannot distinguish those groups. Thus the cell and some average heavy-atom intensity information may be supported, but the submitted symmetry, coordinates, coordination framework, and element ordering are not, and a chemically constrained symmetry/order search is warranted.
